list_kpis.description: List the approved institution KPI ids, names and domains.

get_kpi_value.description: Compute one approved KPI for the current reporting period. Optionally restrict to a department category ('circuit' or 'core').

get_kpi_target.description: Get the approved target for a KPI and the authority that set it.

get_external_benchmark.description: Get the published peer benchmark for a KPI. Many KPIs have none; the call then returns an error and you must say so.
